conventions.ends: on the door's frame line (centre of the wall core where the frames sit; centre of the wall-end faces where there is no frame), at the faces of the wall ends that bound the opening
conventions.width: wall-end face to wall-end face (the fill and the wall's end lines stop there; the frames stand inside the opening). clearWidth = between the frame legs, given for information
conventions.kinds: door (walkable, with a leaf), passage (walkable gap, no leaf), window (none in this drawing: there is no window layer or family; the facade glazing is curtain wall)
conventions.curtainWall: the six curtain-wall bays are a glass wall, not window or door openings (no door is drawn in any of them); not listed as openings

The column (S-COLS x 20.262-20.762) stands in the alcove flush with the corridor face. Ends = column's east face (20.762) and the face of the alcove's east end wall (21.937). Nothing marks an opening on this line (no head, frame, threshold or leaf, nothing drawn across); behind it is only the 0.30 m reveal of door P10, not a space. The opening here is door P10, 0.30 m behind. If recess mouths between a wall end and a column were counted as passages this would be one, but I do not think it is an opening.

otherNotes: Every door symbol of the drawing was accounted for: 16 hinged swings on A-DOOR (6 exploded doors with 7 leaves, and 6 door blocks with 9), 4 pocket doors (4 slide arrows), 1 bi-fold, 4 glass doors (A-DOOR-HDLN). 15 of these doors are covered by places; the other 6 are N1, N2 and N5-N8 above.
All 16 real places have the claimed kind and a width equal to mine (to 1 mm).

P02 and P09 are my least certain verdicts: geometrically the corridor wall line is interrupted there (wall on both sides in line, a column between), but the gaps only lead into a 0.30 m door recess; the doors behind them (P23, P10) are the openings.

Not listed as openings: the curtain-wall bays (glass wall), the open plan between the BAR and the LIVING & DINING AREA (no wall line), the corridor's 0.35 m widening x 17.14-20.44, y 3.31-3.66 east of P11 (nothing drawn across), the luggage-rack niche in bedroom 2's west wall (x 20.61-20.79, y 7.54-8.61).
